title: tutor-ask/1: the request of a student to the tutor
description: Read by `mzlab_tutor::ask::parse` (crates/mzlab-tutor). Unknown keys are refused. Errors are keys: err.tutor.request (malformed field) and err.tutor.too_long (question over 600 characters, more than 2 earlier turns, or earlier turns over 1 500 characters together).

course.description: course code told in the classroom; the Worker keeps only its HMAC

client.description: 128 random bits made in the browser at first use

where.description: the section the student has open: file#anchor, or file

history.description: earlier turns; all the questions and answers together at most 1 500 characters

share.description: level b: the student agrees to share this question, anonymously
